openingRequest.zh-CN: 请帮助我们设计一个只读的数据分析代理，让业务人员用自然语言问数仓，并在写库和跨部门宽表上保留人工。
openingRequest.en-US: Please help us design a read-only data-analysis agent so business users can ask the warehouse in natural language, while keeping humans on warehouse writes and cross-department wide tables.

visibleContext.zh-CN: 我们是一家业务团队会自己取数的公司。管理层希望业务人员能用自然语言问数仓，代理只生成只读 SQL、走 BI 语义层并套行级安全，而不是再做一个迁库项目。
visibleContext.en-US: We are a company whose business teams pull their own numbers. Leadership wants business users to ask the warehouse in natural language. The agent should emit read-only SQL, use the BI semantic layer, and apply row-level security — not become another database-migration project.

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 代理禁止写数仓；跨部门宽表必须先经人工批准（HITL）
visibleConstraints.en-US: The agent must not write the warehouse; cross-department wide tables need human approval (HITL)

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 查询结果中的个人数据不得带出受控分析环境
visibleConstraints.en-US: Personal data in query results must not leave the controlled analytics environment

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 代理不得在语义层未覆盖时裸拼关联
visibleConstraints.en-US: The agent must not freely compose joins when the semantic layer does not cover the metric

visibleConstraints.zh-CN: 允许调用的工具是只读 SQL、BI 语义层和行级安全；代理不得丢掉过滤条件打出明细
visibleConstraints.en-US: Allowed tools are read-only SQL, the BI semantic layer, and row-level security; the agent must not drop filters and dump detail rows

deliverables.zh-CN: 数据分析代理方案设计文档
文本转 SQL 与语义层守门的权衡分析
禁止写库与跨部门宽表批准（HITL）流程
deliverables.en-US: No-write and cross-department wide-table approval (HITL) process

deliverables.zh-CN: 查询安全、语义覆盖与业务自助的度量体系
deliverables.en-US: Query-safety, semantic-coverage, and business-self-serve measurement framework

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你只有12个问题预算来了解这家客户的问数代理现状
learnerRules.en-US: You have a budget of 12 questions to understand this customer's analysis-agent situation

learnerRules.zh-CN: 每个问题必须指定由哪位干系人回答
learnerRules.en-US: Each question must specify which stakeholder will answer

learnerRules.zh-CN: 你需要在DISCOVERY阶段逐步发现隐藏的业务事实
learnerRules.en-US: You need to gradually discover hidden business facts in the DISCOVERY phase

learnerRules.zh-CN: 在PITCH阶段你需要向管理层展示方案并争取批准
learnerRules.en-US: In the PITCH phase, you must present the solution to management for approval
